notes: Pilot 2 (S2S/PSTN): Twilio SIP trunk into LiveKit with Gemini Live; the sole telephony leg in the budget program, isolating transport vs pilot 1. Profile s2s_transport: opaque Gemini Live (no LLM/TTS legs observable); Twilio Media Streams `mark` is playback-COMPLETED, not onset, so it cannot populate audio_first_playout_ms — a caller-boundary loopback capture is required for playout/audible onset (recorded as playback_completed_ms otherwise). turn_gap and transport spans span caller -> Twilio -> LiveKit -> Gemini -> LiveKit -> Twilio, so they are stack-level evidence; pack_metrics stays empty until a span isolates a single provider. Budget-lean cohort: >=120 valid turns (~30-60 call-minutes; expected ~$3-5 for number rental + minutes, cap is retry headroom). Twilio trial accounts are NOT acceptable for measurement (verified-number restriction + trial whisper corrupt the audio path). Same corpus, region, and machine class as pilot 1 so the WebRTC<->PSTN delta is attributable. p99 labeled directional until topped up. Provenance is produced by the adapter at run time into provenance.json. Adapter contract: evals/measure/adapters/README.md.
